description: This file contains the definition of the class 'Modification' within the namespace Opencart.Admin.Controller.Event. It provides methods for handling controller, model, view, and library paths related to modifications in the OpenCart admin extension, including path normalization and file existence checks.

classes.name: Modification
classes.description: Controller class extending the system controller, providing methods for managing paths related to modifications such as controller, model, view, and library within the OpenCart admin extension.

methods.name: controller
methods.description: Resolves the route for controllers within the 'extension/ocmod/' namespace, checking if the file exists and adjusting the route accordingly.

methods.name: model
methods.description: Determines the model class path by extracting the class name from the route, validating file existence, and adjusting the route for model files.

methods.name: view
methods.description: Resolves the view/template file path, checking for existence and adjusting the route accordingly.

methods.name: library
methods.description: Resolves the library file path, verifying file existence, and adjusting the route accordingly.
